title: Hypergeometric Draw Odds
description:
A hypergeometric distribution is a statistical method for calculating the probability of k successes in n draws from a finite population without replacement.

In Spire terms - what are the odds I have weakness next turn?  Can I kill in two?  Should I break Pocketwatch to block an extra 3?  What are the odds that I draw 3 Withers next turn with Fiddle and die??  HELP ME VAKUU!

OK... this mod won't answer those questions DIRECTLY, but it will help you calculate the chance of getting specific cards in the next N cards drawn, based on your current hand, draw pile, and discard pile.

This mod adds a new card view UI that shows your Draw Pile and Reshuffle (discard pile + non-retained cards in hand) together.  The mod calculates the number of cards you will draw on the next turn and lets you select the cards you want to draw (and how many of the cards you want to draw you "need" to draw) and then automagically displays the odds that you will get what you want (or, as is often the case... what you don't want).

Alternatively, you can use "rawdog mode" instead of alt-tabbing to your online calculator of choice.  Amazing!

How to Use:  Press W to open the All Cards view in combat.  Set 'Override Draw Pile button' in the Mod Settings to replace the standard Draw Pile with this mod's All Cards view.

Feedback and feature requests are always welcome!
changeNote: First private build. Testing cross-platform loading.
